About OCC:
A World Class Clearing Organization
The Options Clearing Corporation (OCC) is the world's largest equity derivatives clearing organization. Founded in 1973, OCC is dedicated to promoting stability and market integrity by delivering clearing and settlement services for options, futures and securities lending transactions. As a Systemically Important Financial Market Utility (SIFMU), OCC operates under the jurisdiction of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. OCC has more than 100 clearing members and provides central counterparty (CCP) clearing and settlement services to 21 exchanges and trading platforms.
OCC also provides free and engaging educational resources about the benefits and risks of options through its Options Industry Council (OIC).
OCC is building a culture that empowers continued learning, authentic innovation, and constant creativity.
About the Intern Program:
OCC is looking for interns who are eager to learn, humble enough to ask questions, and ready to think critically about complex problems. The OCC Internship Program equips students with the real-world skills needed to transition successfully into a career in financial services. As an intern, you will contribute to meaningful projects, applying your skills and knowledge to real challenges facing the business. Your time with us is a real opportunity to make a genuine impact on the future of OCC!
OCC's Summer Internship Program is a 12-week opportunity running either May through August or June through September, and is open to undergraduate and graduate students who are actively enrolled at a college or university. Interns work up to 40 hours per week in a hybrid work environment, and overtime is not permitted.
About the Team & Role
The Market Risk team monitors the risk that clearing members bring to OCC’s clearing and settlement services. As a summer intern, you’ll support the team’s daily market risk monitoring, help build Python reports and tools, and learn how a clearinghouse manages risk. You’ll work on a defined project and present your findings to the team at the end of the summer.
Job Summary & Responsibilities
Learn how market risk is measured for the products OCC clears (equities, futures, options, and government securities)
Support the team in monitoring clearing member positions and collateral, using OCC’s risk methodologies such as stress testing
Build or improve small Python scripts and reports using large data sets
Follow financial markets, including earnings and economic announcements, and share how they could affect member portfolios
Collaborate with colleagues on neighboring teams, such as Quantitative Risk and IT
Help with research, data pulls, and documentation for ongoing projects
Present your summer project to the team
Candidate Qualifications
Rising senior or second-year graduate student, graduating December 2027 or May/August 2028.
Desired Majors
Finance, Computer Science, Engineering
Technical Skills/Experience Desired
Some experience with Python (coursework or personal project)
Working knowledge of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Nice to have: SQL, Bloomberg, JIRA, or Confluence
Additional Qualifications
Basic knowledge of statistics, securities markets, and options (coursework counts)
Curiosity, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage your time and ask good questions
Comfort working on multiple tasks with guidance from your team

Are you a curious and open-minded individual with an interest in programming and machine learning? Thomson Reuters Labs is seeking a ML/NLP scientist intern with a passion for problem-solving using state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing techniques.
What does Thomson Reuters Labs do? We experiment, we build, we deliver. We support the organization and our customers through applied research and development of new products and technologies. The Labs innovate collaboratively across our core segments in Legal, Tax & Accounting, Government, and Reuters News. We undertake a diverse portfolio of projects today, while investing in long-term research for the future.
As an Applied Scientist Intern, you will be part of a diverse and interdisciplinary global team of experts. We hire specialists in Information Retrieval, Natural Language Processing, and Machine Learning, as well as Engineering and Design, to drive the company’s digital and AI transformation. Thomson Reuters Labs is known for consistently delivering successful data-driven Artificial Intelligence solutions in support of high-growth products that serve Thomson Reuters customers in new and exciting ways.
Key Responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist Intern, you will:
Experiment and Develop: You can be involved in the entire model development lifecycle, building, testing, and delivering high-quality solutions.
Collaborate: Working on a collaborative cross-functional team, you will learn from and partner with colleagues across the globe.
Innovate: You will have the opportunity to try new approaches and learn new technologies. You will contribute ideas and work on solving real-world challenges.
Required Qualifications
You are a fit for the Applied Scientist Intern role if your background includes some of the following:
Be currently enrolled in a PhD program in a relevant discipline or a Master’s program with research experience.
Have an understanding and experience with Natural Language Processing, and/or Machine Learning methods, including Large Language Models.
Have experience with model training, fine tuning, and evaluating experiments related to Machine Learning or Large Language Models.
Are experienced in one or more programming languages (preferably Python) and have experience working in the Cloud (preferably AWS)
Have experience with ML/NLP libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, spaCy, LangChain, and HuggingFace.
Are comfortable working with unstructured datasets and are knowledgeable about tools and techniques for data cleaning and processing.
Have good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Preferred Qualifications
This is our wish list. We understand that few people check every box. If you are excited about this opportunity, meet most of the following criteria, and are eager to learn, we want to hear from you!
Opportunities For Our Applied Science Interns:
Learning & Development: On-the-job coaching & learning, as well as the opportunity to work with cutting-edge methods and technologies
Data and High-Impact Problems: Our scientists and engineers get to play with large datasets and discover new capabilities and insights in support of our high-impact products and customers. Thomson Reuters is best known for the globally respected Reuters News agency, but our company is also the leading source of information for legal, corporate, and tax & Accounting professionals. We have over 60,000 TBs of legal, regulatory, news, and tax data.
Competitive Compensation: The opportunity to earn while learning new skills

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.
Job Category
Underwriting

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. $25.00 - $26.00
Target Openings
1
What Is the Opportunity?
Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.What Will You Do?
Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
Perform other duties as assigned.
What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?
Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
What is a Must Have?
Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor’s degree.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.
Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

Launch Your Career as a Product Management Intern!
Are you ready to shape the future of agricultural technology and make a tangible impact on global food production? Join Trimble’s Ag Industry Solutions (AgIS) team as a Product Management Intern, where you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, turn customer insights into real-world software solutions, and gain invaluable hands-on leadership experience in an inclusive, high-energy environment.
About Us:
Trimble is an industrial technology company transforming the way the world works by delivering solutions that enable our customers to thrive. We create technologies that connect the digital and physical worlds, helping our customers increase productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability. Within Trimble, the Ag Industry Solutions (AgIS) team empowers farmers and agriculture professionals around the globe by delivering cutting-edge digital and hardware tools that transform farm operations.
What Makes This Role Great:
In this role, you will sit at the intersection of farmer needs and technical execution. You will gain direct experience across the entire product lifecycle—from spending time in the field to understand how machines operate, to creating critical enablement materials that help dealers and internal partners succeed with our newest software features.
Key Responsibilities:
Enablement & Documentation: Create clear, impactful training materials and user documentation for new software features. Validate these instructions directly with internal partners and dealer networks to ensure seamless adoption.
Requirements Gathering & Field Research: Shadow farmers directly on their machines to gain a deep understanding of current system usage, uncover long-term use cases, and define how to scale current technology for future growth.
Customer Voice Translation: Discover and translate real-world farmer and dealer feedback into high-value product requirements and feature sets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with software engineers, product managers, and business teams to align field insights with product roadmaps and build core leadership capabilities.
Essential Skills & Experience:
Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture/Agribusiness, or a related field.
Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally and build effective working relationships.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-centric mindset.
Willingness and enthusiasm to learn agricultural technology systems and spend time in field environments (e.g., inside farm machinery).
Basic familiarity or experience using Google Workspace tools.
Bonus Points For:
Previous experience or exposure to agriculture, farm machinery, or precision farming technology.
Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite or documentation/training creation tools.
Familiarity with product lifecycle management, software documentation, or user research techniques.
Work Authorization: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Candidates must already possess authorization to work in the United States of America without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
Logistics:
Location: Westminster, CO
Travel Requirement: Up to 10% (for on-site field visits with farmers and dealers)
Timing: May – August 2027
Why You'll Love Working With Us:
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that increase farm yields, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for farmers worldwide.
Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

UHY is seeking an intern to join our Technology, Risk, and Compliance (TRC) practice. The intern will work with professionals across a variety of industries and will assist in delivering services aligned to recognized cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, and PCI DSS.

Perform research on cybersecurity requirements, industry practices, and applicable regulatory or framework expectations

None

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and performing work in front of a computer screen for long periods of time

0 – 1 year of relevant experience
Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, information technology, computer science, accounting Information Systems, cybersecurity or a related field

Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion

Experience producing maps and graphics
